editorial.overview: AI Fusion tours Strix's agent tools, specialized security skills, and scan modes, then describes attempts to run it against a local OWASP Juice Shop sandbox. The presenter manually demonstrates the login flaw; Strix produces no confirmed finding in the video.
editorial.whyItMatters: Builders, application security teams, and buyers of AI security tools can use the video to see both the proposed workflow and the integration and budget failures that can stop a scan before it tests a target.
editorial.ghostMeshTakeaway: Evaluate autonomous security tools on an authorized target with visible tool actions, a completed run, explicit coverage, cost, and reproducible findings. Preserve a source-bound run record and require human review before publishing or acting on a result.
editorial.watchGuidance: Watch 00:52–03:23 for architecture and 04:46–05:52 for the local run. Viewers familiar with Juice Shop may skip the opening manual bypass.
editorial.verdict: The presenter manually bypassed Juice Shop; the Strix attempts shown did not produce a confirmed finding. Diagnose structured tool calling before attributing the local stall to model quality alone.
editorial.thesis: A vulnerable training target, an agent architecture, and partial tool calls establish a test setup, not measured detection coverage.
